info.title: Gym SaaS API
info.description: Multi-tenant gym management API. The gym is chosen by the **host** (`<gym>.yourapp.in`); super admin endpoints live on the platform host. Money is integer paise; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the gym's time zone. Full behaviour per endpoint: docs/API.md.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from /api/v1/auth/login or /magic-link/verify (15 min). Refresh via the HttpOnly cookie.

E400.description: Bad request (malformed input, wrong host, invalid link/signature/pass)

E401.description: Not signed in, token expired, or token from another gym/host

E403.description: Signed in but not allowed (missing permission, suspended gym)

E404.description: Not found (also for records of other gyms)

E409.description: Conflict with current state (duplicates, overlaps, wrong status)
